== What is khanary? ==
KHANARY is a semantic neural compute substrate built on top of llama.cpp inference. It adds deterministic orchestration, micronaut behavior profiles, Atomic DOM manifests, and authority-separated execution via native driver DLLs. Project root: C:\Users\canna\_khanary_inspect\.

== WebX and BOSS ==
WebX (v3.5.0) is the native compute engine runtime at C:\Users\canna\.NNC-K\bin\v3.5.0-WebX. The BOSS orchestrator (BOSSOrchestrator in webx_boss.cpp) manages layered execution: Layer 1 = model execution, Layer 2 = routing/load balancing, Layer 3 = caching/optimization, Layer 4 = tuning, Layer 5 = metadata/context, Layer 6 = security/filtering, Layer 7 = monitoring. WebX Native implements BOSS layers 1-3. BOSS dispatches to the FieldGraph which manages semantic field state (entropy, attention, pressure, gravity). The kuhul_task_boss MCP tool (exposed on kuhul-server :8764) dispatches admitted TaskLists through the BOSS FieldGraph.

== Ports and services ==
- kuhul-server: 8764 — MCP gateway, micronaut registry, REST /micronauts /mcp /api/plan
- kuhul_engine: 17480 — model inference server (OpenAI-compatible)

== Native drivers (drivers/) ==

- khanary_glyph_driver.dll: K'UHUL phase/fold glyph registry (12 phase opcodes 0x5000-0x500b)

- gl_infer_driver.dll: OpenGL 4.3 compute inference probe (currently stubbed)

== K'UHUL phases ==
Pop (0x5000, observe/read context) → Wo (0x5001, schedule/plan) → Yax (0x5002, branch/explore) → Sek (0x5003, execute) → Ch'en (0x5004, verify constraints) → Xul (0x5005, emit/persist to SCXcache).

== Planner / executor split ==
PM-1 / MicrosoftSDK.ps1 is the PLANNER — produces declarative TaskList JSON. TaskEngine.cpp inside khanary_driver.dll is the EXECUTOR (C++ authority) — validates, resolves providers, checks DAG, runs tasks. Model output is advisory only.

== Micronauts ==
Behavior profile JSON files in micronauts/*.json. Selected per prompt intent by kuhul-server. Selection injects system context to ground teacher responses. Categories: system, specialist, persona, meta, stack, fold.

== Atomic DOM ==
Each model has atomic.manifest.json defining chat_template, npc.system_prompt, sampling defaults, tool registry, and model weight paths. Runtime reads it; raw JSON is never sent to the model.
